_help: Cau hinh chung. Sua duong dan / bat-tat Firefly o day. Khong can biet code.

old_stamp_cleanup._help: Cach lam sach vung stamp cu truoc khi ve stamp moi.
old_stamp_cleanup._mode_options: cover = phu 1 dai mo/lam toi len vung stamp cu (mien phi, offline). firefly = dung Adobe Firefly Generative Fill xoa sach stamp cu (can ban quyen API).

cover._style_options: scrim = gradient toi dan (dep tren anh sach, che stamp cu tot), darken = toi deu, blur = lam mo, solid = mau dac

firefly._help: Dien client_id / client_secret tu Adobe Developer Console. De trong => tool dung che do 'cover'.
firefly.fill_prompt: clean natural background, seamless, photorealistic, no text, no watermark
